name: Tune in to the show
source:
After two years of living in solitude, a chance to start anew presents itself when you get chosen as a participant in a new TV show. You’ll be living with 7 strangers for a month, and romance is strongly encouraged!

[from [url=https://robertdeadth.itch.io/titts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
獨自生活兩年後，你被選為一檔新電視節目的參與者，終於有了重新開始的機會。你將與7名陌生人同住一個月，而且節目非常鼓勵談戀愛！

[摘自[url=https://robertdeadth.itch.io/titts]Itch.io[/url]]
